svg.title: Waypoint Room heat pump comfort portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional heating and cooling portfolio concept for Waypoint Room, showing a wall-mounted heat-pump comfort system in a bright living room. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
